_comment: DRAFT study tracks for touge-lines-v1 (Barry, 2026-11-13). Not live: do not copy into sim/config. Replaces the 15 stand-in laps in sim/config/tracks_v1.json (5 per district) with Austin's 2026-11-13 count: Street and Wangan are 2 layouts x CW/CCW (4 variants each); Touge is 1 layout x uphill/downhill (2 variants). 10 variants total. design/01 still says 3 tracks per district (Austin 2026-11-12) and will need updating — flagged only, not edited.

sources.why: T1 is the hairpin-heavy switchback stand-in (Touge signature corners HP/ES/DR). S1 is the Street grid (signature N90+CH); S3 is a second Street layout with more chicanes and mixed types. W1 is the open-highway Bayshore stand-in (signature SW/IR/CR); W3 is a second Wangan loop (adds an N90). CW/uphill = the authored tracks_v1.json order. Other stand-ins (T2-T5, S2/S4/S5, W2/W4/W5) are dropped for this study.

assumptions.reverse: CCW and downhill reverse the corner order.
assumptions.ir_dr_flip: IR and DR swap when the lap is reversed (an increasing-radius corner is a decreasing-radius corner in the other direction). HP, ES, CH, N90, CR, SW are treated as direction-symmetric. The sim has no left/right handedness, so CW vs CCW is order plus this IR/DR flip only.
assumptions.grade_source: unapproved/arthur/mockups/districts/README.md Pass 2 (Austin 2026-11-13) and CHANGELOG 2026-11-13 Arthur: Touge climbs at 8.5% on the approach, crests in the hairpin (0% at ~75% of the arc), falls at 5% out of it, banks up to 6%. Street and Wangan stay flat. That pass was presentation-only (scoring/sim unchanged). There is no published sim rule for uphill vs downhill heat; the gravity tilt below is a PLACEHOLDER that reuses those grade percents.
assumptions.gravity: On Touge only, after track_wear and before capacity calibration, multiply wear POW/HAN/EN then renormalise so the lap's total load is unchanged. Uphill (climbing the 8.5% approach, with 5% drops still in the profile): POW*(1+0.085), HAN*1, EN*(1-0.05). Downhill (reversed hairpin: 5% local climbs, 8.5% drops): POW*(1-0.05), HAN*1, EN*(1+0.085). Street and Wangan stay flat (multiplier 1). PLACEHOLDER pending Austin.
